book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Mataayo

content: Yeesu arakeerenia iguru yo okugwiisibhwa kwe eriiseengerero
Yeesu akatanura mwiiseengerero rya Taatabhugya. Hano yaakurwa muyo, abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakamutuniirira okubha bhamweerekye kyeego amakiindaasi ge eriiseengerero rya Taatabhugya gari.
Nawe Yeesu akabhabhuurira, “Muruuzi bhuzomu amakiindaasi goosi gano? Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, ritariho eriigina rino riraatame iguru we eriindi, goosi garagwiisibhwa!”
Yeesu arakeerenia iguru ye enyaako ehaari yino ekuuza

Ambe, Yeesu akagya mu Kiguru kye Emizeituni, akiikara hayo. Abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakamutuniirira hayo abheene ego, bhakamubhuurya, “Otubhuurire, amangʼana gayo garatuuka ryoori? Kweeki, niki kino kiraatweerekye okukyoora kwaazo no okuhika kwo obhuteero bhwe ekyaaro?”
Yeesu akabhakyoora, “Mwiiriihe, omuutu wowoosi ataaza kubhangʼeena!
Abhaatu bhaaru bharaaza bhakuhokeerya eriina ryaane, bharabhuga, ‘Enye neenye Masiya!’ Abhaatu bhayo bharangʼeena abhaatu bhaaru.
“Kwiibhaga riyo, murabha muriigwa amangʼana ge eriihi no obhuzuuzumi bhwe eriihi. Mutaaza kuhahibhwa, gayo gareenderwa gatuuke, nawe obhuteero bhwe ekyaaro bhurabha bhukyaari kuhika.
Ekyaaro kimwe kirarwaana ne ekyaaro ekiindi, no obhutemi obhumwe bhurarwaana no obhutemi obhuundi. Enzara ne ebhirigito bhye esi bhirabha bhiratuuka ahagiro hoosi.
Gayo goosi garabha kyo obhweemero bhwo obhusuungu bhwo omukari wuno akweenda okwiituurania.
Kwiibhaga riyo, abhaatu bharabha bharabhakorera emikoonyo, muranyaakibhwa no okwiitwa, na abhaatu bhe ebhyaaro bhyoosi bharabhabhiihirirwa kwe ekigirye kyo okubha emwe ni bhaanabheega bhaane.
Niho abhaatu bhaaru bharaaza kutiga okunituniirira. Bharabha bharakorerana emikoonyo no okubhiihirania abheene kwa abheene.
“Kwiibhaga riyo, bharabha bharatuuka abharooti bhaaru bho orurimi, bharangʼeena abhaatu bhaaru.
Kweeki, obhuseegi bhwa abhaatu bhaaru bhurasuuha, kwo okubha ebhibhi bhirabha bhyaaruhiri.
Nawe omuutu wowoosi wuno araagumire tee obhuteero, niwe araatuuribhwe.

Amangʼana Amazomu iguru yo obhutemi bhwa mwiisaaro garabha gararwaazwa mukyaaro kyoosi. Kwiibhaga rino abhaatu bhe ebhyaaro bhyoosi bharabha bhabhweeni omweeya gwo okwiigwa obhwiimeerereri bhuyo, niho obhuteero bhwe ekyaaro bhuraahike.
Orusiku rwe enyaako ekuru mukyaaro kya Yudea
“Kurabha ne eriibhaga hano muraarore kino omurooti Danieri yagaambiri, eriibhiihiriryo rirya rino rikureeta amakire, riimeereeri ahagiro ahahoreeru he eriiseengerero rya Taatabhugya.
Omuutu wowoosi wuno akusoma amangʼana gano, amenye bhuzomu obhugazuro bhwago.
Hayo, abhaatu bhoosi bhano bhakwiikara mukyaaro kya Yudea, bhangʼosere mubhiguru!
Omuutu wuno ari iguru kukisara, yiike angʼose, atasikira munyuumba okubha agege ebhigiro bhyaaye.
Egoego, omuutu wuyo woosi wuno akubha mumuguundu, angʼose, atakyoora owaaye okugega ekabhuuti yaaye.
Turabharorera ebhigoongi, abhakari bhano bharitohiri na bhano bhakukookya abhaana muziisiku ziyo!
Kweego, mumusabhe Taatabhugya kubha okuryaara kweenyu kutaaza kubha mwiibhaga rya nyamabheho naabhe kurusiku rwo okumuunya.
Eheene, muziisiku ziyo, abhaatu bharabhona eziinyaako kuru bhukongʼu. Eziinyaako kya ziyo, zikyaari kutuuka kweema obhweemero bhwe ekyaaro tee reero yino, na zitakuuza kutuuka kweeki.
Eraabhe Taatabhugya atiingazisuuhirye eziisiku ziyo munyaako yiyo, atariho omuutu wuno yiingatuuriibhwe. Nawe Taatabhugya ararisuuhya eriibhaga riyo, kwiiguru ya abhasorwa bhaaye.
“Kwe eriibhaga riyo, kyo omuutu arabhabhuurira, ‘Rora, Masiya ari hano!’ kasi ‘Ari harya!’ mutaaza kwiikirirya.

Bharabhaho abharooti bho orurimi na abhaatu bhano bhakwiibhirikira kubha ni Masiya. Bhareerekya ebhyeerekenio ne ebhiruguuro, okubha bhasakye okubhangʼeena abhaatu, eraabhe eraturikana naabhe bhano bhasorirwe na Taatabhugya.
Mwiiriihe! Nibhabhuuriiri gakyaari kutuuka.
Eraabhe abhaatu bharabhabhuurira, ‘Rora, Krisito ari mwiitirigo erya!’ mutaaza kugya eyo. Kasi bharaabhuge, ‘Rora, yiibhisiri munyuumba muyo!’ mutaaza kwiikirirya.
Mumenye kubha okuuza kweenye Omwaana wo Omuutu, kurabha kyeego orumesyo rukumesya ruguru tee nyaanza.
Amangʼana gararorekana kubhweero, eraabhe hano mukurora amatoonyi giikumaniirye, niho ekituundu kiri.
Yeesu aragaambira okukyoora kwaaye

“Ambe, hano eziisiku ziyo zye enyaako zihitiri, eryoobha riratuurirwa ekiirima, omweeri gutakuruusya obhweero bhwaku, ne eziinzota ziragwa haasi okurwa kwiisaaro. Taatabhugya arabhisiingisya ebhigiro bhyoosi bhya mwiisaaro.

“Niho, ekyeerekenio kyeenye Omwaana wo Omuutu kiraaza kurarorekana mwiisaaro, na abhaatu bhe eziingaanda zyoosi mukyaaro bharataanga kurira kwe ehaho. Hano ndaaze, abhaatu bhoosi bharanirora, nikuuza mumasaaro kwo obhuturo bhwaaru no obhuguungo.
Niho ndaragania bhamaraika bhaane, bhateme ekoombyo bhukongʼu, okubha bhakumanie abhasorwa bhaane okurwa mbaara zyoosi zye ekyaaro.”

Yeesu akageenderera kugaamba, “Mweege amangʼana ge ekireengyo okurwa kumuti gwo omutiini. Hano mukurora amatu garasibhuka na amasagya garabharya amatu, nikyo ekigirirye kyo okumenya kubha eriibhaga rya amaahu rihikiri.
Egoego na neemwe, hano muraarore gayo goosi gataangiri kukorwa, mumenye kubha niri haguhi kuuza.
Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, orwiibhuro runo rutakuhita, tee gano goosi garaamarwe kukorwa.
Eriisaaro ne ekyaaro bhirahweerera, nawe amangʼana gaane gatakuhweerera na rumwe.

“Nawe iguru wa amangʼana go orusiku ne eriibhaga runo Omwaana wo Omuutu araaze, atariho omuutu wuno amenyiri. Naabhe bhamaraika bha mwiisaaro, naabhe Omwaana, bhoosi bhatamenyiri, nawe Taata waane omweene niwe amenyiri.
Kweego, okuuza kwaane enye Omwaana wo Omuutu, kurabha kyeego yaari kuziisiku zya Nuhu.
Muziisiku ziyo hano embura yo omusabhuko yaari ekyaari kuuza, abhaatu bhaari bhararya no okunywa, bhaari bharakweera no okukweerwa, tee kurusiku runo Nuhu yasikiiri musafina.
Abhaatu bhayo, bhataamenyiri niki kiraatuuke, tee hano omusabhuko gwiiziri no okubhiita bhoosi. Ego niigo eraabhe eriibhaga enye Omwaana wo Omuutu ndaaze.
Kwe eriibhaga riyo, abhaatu bhabhiri bharabha mumuguundu, owumwe aragegwa no owuundi aratama.
Kweeki abhakari bhabhiri bharabha bharasya hamwe kurubhwe, owumwe aragegwa no owuundi aratama.
Ambe muteengeeze, kwo okubha mutamenyiri ni rusikuki runo enye Omukuru weenyu nikuuza.
“Nawe mumenye kisi kubha, kyeego mweene nyuumba yiingamenyiri eriibhaga rino omwiibhi akuuza, ambe ataari kuhiindira okubha omwiibhi ataaza akasarya enyuumba yaaye.
Kweego ambe, na neemwe mwiibhanure eriibhaga ryoosi, kwo okubha enye Omwaana wo Omuutu ndaaza kwiibhaga rino mutakwiisiga.”
Ekireengyo kyo omugya omwiikirirya na wuno atari omuheene

Yeesu akabhabhuurya abhaanabheega bhaaye, “Ambe, ni weewi omugya omwiikirirya na wa amangʼeeni? Ni mugya wuno omukuru waaye amutuuriri abhe omwiimeerereri wa abhagya abhaandi munyuumba yaaye, okubha abhe arabhaha ebhyaakurya kwe eriibhaga rino rikweenderwa.
Omukuru waabhu araakyoore kurwa orugeendo, no okumubhona omugya wuyo arakora ego, niho araabhone orubhaango.
Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, omukuru waaye aramukora abhe omwiimeerereri we ebhigiro bhyaaye bhyoosi.
“Nawe eraabhe omugya wurya ni mubhiihu, akwiiseega mukoro yaaye, ‘Omukuru waane akezeeri bhukongʼu kukyoora.’
Niho akutaanga kutema abhagya abharikyaaye, arazomererwa okurya no okunywa amaanzi go omuzabibu hamwe na abhanywi abharaara.
Ambe, omukuru waaye araakyoore kurwa orugeendo, araaza orusiku runo omugya atakumwiiseegera eriibhaga rino atamenyiri.
Niho omukuru waaye aramutema bhukongʼu no okumurekera hano abhabheehi bhari. Eyo niyo bhakubha bhararira no okusaanania ameeno.”
